title: MGSM Stage-1 extraction schema v2
description: Week 7 Task 3 fix. v1's schema was a flat array of {quantity, role} entries, with no dedicated place to express 'the unknown quantity to be solved for' -- the Critic+Repair baseline (Week 6) worked around this by appending a quantities-array entry like {"quantity": 0, "role": "target: total weight..."}, which looks like a real data point and corrupted at least one otherwise-correct Stage 2 run (mgsm_207, see results/week6_task4_error_analysis_summary.md). v2 separates 'things that were measured' (quantities, unchanged in spirit from v1) from 'the thing to be computed' (target, a dedicated non-numeric object), so there is no numeric placeholder for Stage 2 to mistake for a real value.

quantities.description: Every quantity mentioned in the problem and the role it plays -- same spirit as v1, unchanged.

quantity.description: A real, given or computable numeric value from the problem. Never a placeholder for an unknown -- unknowns belong in 'target', not here.

role.description: Short English label for what this quantity represents and how it is used.

target.description: The unknown quantity Stage 2 must solve for -- deliberately NOT part of the quantities array, and deliberately has no 'quantity' field, so there is no numeric placeholder (e.g. 0) that could be mistaken for a real, known value.

entity.description: What the final answer refers to, in plain English -- e.g. 'total weight of all candy', 'how many more candies John has than James', 'Sylvie's annual salary'. Must distinguish a total/sum from one specific entity's value, and a difference from an absolute value -- this is exactly what v1's 'target/question intent loss' failures (Week 6 Task 1, 11/25 cases) lost.

operation.description: How to combine the quantities to get the answer -- e.g. 'sum', 'difference', 'one entity's derived value', 'ratio', 'repeated application (apply per-year increase 3 times)'. Exists because Week 6 Task 4 found an aggregation-relation failure (mgsm_087) where the right numbers were extracted but nothing said the per-year increase had to be applied 3 separate times, not once.

output_unit.description: The unit the final numeric answer must be expressed in -- e.g. 'dollars' (not cents), 'hours' (not minutes), 'kilometers'. Use null only if the problem is a bare count with no unit. Exists because Week 6 Task 1 found 6/25 failures were exactly this: the right number computed in the wrong unit (mgsm_151 cents vs. dollars, mgsm_228 minutes vs. hours, mgsm_173 monthly vs. annual).

quantities.role: multiplier: white fiber = half the blue fiber amount

target.entity: total bolts of fiber needed (blue + white)

quantities.role: cost in cents to inflate one tire
number of bicycle customers, each with 2 tires
number of tricycle customers, each with 3 tires
number of unicycle customers, with 1 tire

target.entity: total amount Shawnda made that day
target.operation: sum of (tires inflated x cost per tire), converted from cents
